artworks.title: Edmond Pigalle
artworks.medium: etching in black on cream laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the waist up, in a profile view facing left. He wears a brimmed hat tilted back on his head, revealing a balding pate, and has a prominent mustache. His face shows wrinkles indicating maturity. He wears traditional attire with a collared shirt, tie, vest, and coat. The man rests his chin on his right hand. The background is plain, emphasizing the figure's profile and detailed ink work. In the upper left corner, there is faint writing or a signature. The monochromatic style gives the image an antique look.

artworks.title: Jules Destrée
artworks.medium: etching and dry point on Fabriano wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell
artworks.description: The image displays a detailed close-up drawing of a person's head and upper shoulders, with a neutral expression. The person's head is slightly turned to the right, showing distinct facial features like a pronounced brow line, a mustache, and a strong jawline. The thick hair flows outward to the sides, partially covering the ears and extending down to the neck. The clothing is minimally detailed, suggesting a simple collar. There are no visible accessories or objects held. The background is plain and textured, emphasizing the intricacy of the facial details in the drawing.

artworks.title: Jules Destrée
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on Fabriano wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell
artworks.description: The image depicts a detailed drawing of a man's face, facing forward with a slight turn to the right. The man has prominent eyebrows, a broad forehead, a mustache, and medium-length hair styled loosely back. He appears to be wearing a simple shirt. The background is plain with abstract, textured lines.

artworks.title: Jules Destrée
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell
artworks.description: The image is a close-up portrait of a man's head and partial neck, capturing a frontal view of his face with a slight turn towards the right side. His facial features are detailed, with a prominent mustache and a textured appearance suggesting facial hair. His hair is dark and somewhat untamed, with strands swept back on his left side and slightly flaring out on his right. The man wears a light-colored, high-collared garment that suggests a shirt or a jacket. The background is plain and neutral, emphasizing the sketched details without any additional scenery or objects encroaching into the visual space.

artworks.title: Jules Destrée
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on Arches laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell
artworks.description: The image shows a man with a mustache, facing slightly to the right. He has distinct facial features and medium-length hair. He appears to be wearing a garment with a high collar. The background is a textured, light surface.

artworks.title: Jules Destrée
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint with black ink additions on Van Gelder laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell
artworks.description: The image shows a close-up, head-and-shoulders portrait of a man facing slightly to the right. His face displays strong, defined features with a prominent mustache, a slight beard, and high cheekbones. His hair appears dark, medium-length, and somewhat tousled. He is wearing a high-collared shirt that appears to be tightly buttoned around the neck. The background is plain and textured, emphasizing the focus on the man's expression and the contrast of light and shadow across his face. There are no visible jewelry or objects he is holding.

artworks.title: Jules Destrée
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man with his head and part of his shoulders visible. His face is turned slightly to his left, and he appears to be looking slightly downward with a focused expression. The man's facial features include a prominent mustache and a slight beard, with high cheekbones and expressive eyes. His hair is dark, straight, and unkempt, extending past his ears. He is wearing a high-collared garment. The background is a textured, shadowy surface with a scribbled effect. The artwork includes the date "Rome 1917" inscribed on it, along with an unreadable signature at the bottom.

artworks.title: Jules Destrée
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on Van Gelder laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man. He is facing slightly to the right with expressive eyes, prominent eyebrows, a rounded nose, and a mustache. His dark, wavy hair is swept to the sides. He is wearing a high-collared garment with a dark band around the neck. The background is plain with a lightly textured surface. The piece is signed and dated "Rome 1917" on the left side.

artworks.title: Jules Destrée
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on BFK Rives laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person with a focus on the head and neck, particularly the face. The individual is facing slightly left with their gaze turned to the side. The face is detailed, showing features like a mustache, facial hair, and expressive eyes. The dark hair is slightly parted and falls around the head. The person wears a light-colored garment with a high collar close to the neck. The background is simple with subtle textures. The inscription "Rome" and the date "1917" are on the left side of the image.

artworks.title: Jules Destrée
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a man's face shown from the shoulders up, with a focus on his facial features. The man's head is slightly turned to the side, and he appears to be looking to his left. His facial features are distinctly drawn with a pronounced mustache and textured hair that is parted in the middle. The man is wearing a garment with a high collar, which is visible at the base of his neck. There are no visible jewelry or objects being held in the image. The background is plain and unadorned. The sketch has an etched and textured appearance.

artworks.title: Georges Clemenceau
artworks.medium: drypoint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell
artworks.description: The image shows the head and upper neck of an older man in a close-up portrait format. The man has deeply set and shadowed eyes, prominent eyebrows, a large nose, and a full mustache covering his upper lip. His facial hair is thin and appears rough. The man is bald with sparse hair on the sides, depicted with delicate crosshatching. He is looking slightly downward with a contemplative expression. There are no visible details of clothing or jewelry, and the background is plain.

artworks.title: Sorrow (Chagrin)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on Van Gelder laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an abstract form on a patterned surface. It features a series of etched lines and shapes suggesting a fluid, organic form resting on a textured surface. The background has vertical lines. The monochrome palette and sketch-like quality give the artwork a raw and intimate feel.

artworks.title: Pompilia
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell
artworks.description: The image depicts a bust-length portrait of a person in a contemplative pose. The individual has long, dark hair, closed or partially closed eyes, and is wearing a patterned garment. The image is monochromatic with a textured appearance, and the background is a simple, textured surface.

artworks.title: Peppina
artworks.medium: etching with graphite additions on Van Gelder laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell
artworks.description: The image depicts a person in a head-and-shoulders view. The individual is positioned slightly turned to the side with their head tilted towards the viewer. Their facial features include prominent eyes, a subtle smile, and a relatively smooth complexion. The person's hair is dark and appears short, styled closely around the head. They are wearing a simple garment suggested by the etching strokes with no intricate details visible. No jewelry or objects are evident in the person's attire or within their grasp. The background consists of a textured pattern created by consistent cross-hatching, giving the piece depth and focus on the subject.

artworks.title: Peppina
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell
artworks.description: The image shows a partial view of a person's upper body, primarily focusing on the face and shoulders. The person is in a three-quarter position, turning slightly to one side. The facial features are drawn with prominently drawn eyes and a delicate smile. The person has textured, voluminous hair that frames the face. The clothing depicted is simple with horizontal lines suggesting fabric folds around the shoulders. There are no visible items of jewelry or objects being held. The background is a subtle, blurred texture with cross-hatching.

artworks.title: Peppina
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of a woman from the shoulders up. She is facing slightly to the right with her head turned towards the viewer. The woman has delicate facial features and a composed expression. Her hair is styled in an updo. She appears to be wearing a patterned garment. The background is textured with fine lines. There are no visible jewelry or objects in the image.

artworks.title: Birth Announcement for Anne-Élisabeth Besnard (Carte de naissance d'Anne-Élisabeth Besnard)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell
artworks.description: The image shows two figures. On the left, an elderly person is standing and holding an infant. The elderly person has spectacles and a headscarf, wearing a long garment with textured patterns. The infant is wrapped up. On the right, another person is reclining on a bed, partially covered by a blanket and pillows. The background shows a patterned wall or curtain and a bedpost.

artworks.title: Seated Nude with a Cigarette
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell
artworks.description: The artwork depicts the upper body of a person seated in a three-quarter view. The person is leaning with their left arm resting on a surface while their right hand holds a small object, possibly a flower. The facial features of the person are softly rendered, with a focus on their large eyes and serene expression. The person's hair is styled in a wavy bob that falls around their face. The figure is nude from the waist up, partially draped with a cloth or blanket across the lap. The background is textured with cross-hatching and shading, creating a neutral space that emphasizes the subject's presence.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait
artworks.medium: collotype in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell
artworks.description: The image is an illustration of the upper half of a man's body. He is shown in a relaxed, frontal position with a beard, mustache, and short hair. His eyes are looking forward. He is wearing a loose garment or cloak, and the sketch is set against a plain background with shading lines. The artist's signature and the date "1893" are visible beside the man's head.

artworks.title: A Cottage at Dorking in Surrey
artworks.medium: gray wash and graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a rustic half-timbered building with a sharp, angular roof. The horizon is in the middle with a faint misty line hinting at distant land and possibly water. A lone figure stands nearby. The building has clean lines and soft brushstrokes to depict the texture of the walls. The color scheme is mostly monochromatic with shades of grey, beige, and soft sepia. The brushstrokes create a serene atmosphere, suggesting shadows over the landscape and trees in the background blending into the sky.

artworks.title: Male Nude
artworks.medium: red chalk heightened with white on brown paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal
artworks.description: This drawing depicts a figure in a dynamic stance, with one arm bent and the other extended out to the right. The figure's head is partially obscured, turned to the right and tilted slightly back. They appear to have short, curly hair. The person is nude, with some curling, scribbled lines around the waist and groin. One of the person's legs is also bent, resting on an indistinct block on the left. The person casts a shadow below them and to the left, but aside from that the background is empty. The drawing has been done in red on beige paper.

artworks.title: Male Nude
artworks.medium: red chalk on tan oatmeal paper, heightened with white chalk
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal

artworks.title: Emigrants
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Ruth Ivor
artworks.description: Four people are depicted from head to knee, positioned closely together. On the left, a person wearing a dotted headscarf is seated, resting their head on their hand and looking downward. Next to them, a person with short, dark hair partially covered by a dark scarf gazes intently ahead. They are dressed in a dark coat. The third person is mostly covered by a patterned blanket, hiding most of their features except for a glimpse of their closed eyes and part of their face. Standing behind them is a person with a textured beard, wearing a cap and long dark clothing, appearing to look downwards towards the group. The background is a simple textured surface.

artworks.title: Invention d'une Cascade (Design for a Cascade)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts an intricate fountain surrounded by decorative elements in a garden. The fountain features ornate detailing, including sculptural figures and foliage. Elegantly dressed individuals are near the fountain. The scene is framed by scrollwork and floral motifs. The background shows lush greenery, tall trees, a wall, and decorative architectural elements.
